_comment: Pack identity is the YOLTON e-bike pack (Coupang 9101801616), https://www.coupang.com/vp/products/9101801616?vendorItemId=93727752087 . Chemistry, voltages, capacity, cell configuration, and currents stay null. The fetched listing title is a selectable 12 V lithium-ion family (5-45 Ah), seller 주식회사 볼턴, and the page body showed vendor item 26870346028 rather than 93727752087. Volton's 12 V 45 Ah page (https://www.voltonbattery.com/12v/?idx=407) lists the same 236000 KRW price and LG lithium-ion cells, but that does not confirm this vendor item and it does not give series count, max or min voltage, or current. Do not copy a title or a price match into these fields. The monitor refuses to open the real sensor while the nameplate fields are null. shunt_resistance_ohm, shunt_rated_current_a, ina228_address, and adc_range_mv are Matek I2C-INA-BM module facts (https://www.mateksys.com/?portfolio=i2c-ina-bm and TI SLYS021), not a guess at the pack. Do not copy the example profile. UART is optional and unused: uart_enabled stays false. The live path is I2C on /dev/i2c-7, then state.json.
